name: @examples/inline-es-toolkit
//dependencies: es-toolkit is pinned to an exact version because #10's PoC measures the
flattened artifact for *this* version: an `inline` decision compiles the
package's own code into the Cell, so a range that could resolve differently
would silently change the evidence. The import in `src/App.tsx` stays an
ordinary ESM import — no Forguncy extension and no `frontendLibraries`
reference exists for it, which is exactly the claim this example proves.
